name: University of Toronto
description: The University of Toronto is a public research university in Toronto, Ontario, founded in 1827. It has three campuses and is known for medicine, engineering, computer science and the humanities.
whyIncluded: Among the most-searched overseas universities from Singapore in 2025 (KiasuParents, a Singapore parents' website), and its Temerty Faculty of Medicine MD is on the Singapore Medical Council's list.

livingCosts.summary: The university's own monthly estimate for a student renting off campus, over an 8-month academic year: rent and utilities, food, transport, phone, clothing, entertainment and books.
livingCosts.notes: U of T Student Life 'Living costs in Toronto' 2026 monthly estimates for a student renting off campus (not specific to international students); ranges taken at their midpoint. Housing = rent $1,220-$2,700 (1,960) + hydro $65+ (65) + internet $60-$115 (87.50) + tenant's insurance $30-$50 (40). Food & grocery $350+ (350). Transportation $0-$150 (75). Personal = phone $50-$100 (75) + clothing & shoes $50-$100 (75) + entertainment & other $200 + books & supplies $550/semester (2 semesters over 8 months = 137.50). Months = 8-month academic year (Sep-Apr, two semesters; the page gives monthly figures only). One-off $550 emergency fund excluded.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Applied Science (Engineering)
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students. Not fixed: fees also rise for continuing students. Compulsory incidental fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 full-time international tuition; compulsory = incidental fees C$2,266.83 (UHIP C$948 excluded). Not fixed: fee reports raise engineering international fees for continuing students too. 2024 from 2024-25 Tuition Fee Report (Entering 2024).

programmes.name: Juris Doctor (JD), Faculty of Law
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students in the 3-year graduate-entry law degree. Rises each year. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international JD program fee C$72,790 (charged per academic year, not per course) from the U of T Tuition Explorer fee schedule; compulsory = Year 1 incidental and system access fees C$2,165.31 (C$2,115.31 in Years 2-3). UHIP (C$948) excluded. JD is graduate-entry (3 years). International fee rises yearly (2026-27 Tuition Fee Report: C$76,430 for 2027-28). 2025 from the Tuition Explorer 2025-26 schedule; 2024 from the 2024-25 Tuition Fee Report (Table D, international JD C$66,020; fees not found).

programmes.name: Doctor of Medicine (MD), Temerty Faculty of Medicine
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students in the 4-year graduate-entry Doctor of Medicine; international places are limited. Rises each year. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international Doctor of Medicine tuition C$100,270 from the Planning & Budget 2026-27 Tuition Fee Report (international fee schedule; C$103,280 approved for 2027-28). Compulsory = St. George campus incidental + ancillary fees C$2,535.05 for 2026-27 from the MD Program 'Current Fees' page (Mississauga Academy differs); UHIP excluded. MD is graduate-entry (4 years); international places are limited. 2024 and 2025 from the 2025-26 Tuition Fee Report (C$94,510 for 2024-25, C$97,350 for 2025-26); fees for those years not found.

programmes.name: Honours Bachelor of Arts (Humanities / Social Sciences), Faculty of Arts & Science
programmes.summary: Annual tuition for international students; Years 2 to 4 are charged the same rate, but fees rise each year. Compulsory fees included (they vary slightly by college); health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 Faculty of Arts & Science international Year 1 program fee C$66,110 (one fee for every admission stream, charged per academic year) from the U of T Tuition Explorer; compulsory = Year 1 incidental and system access fees C$2,100.29 for a University College student (the fee varies by college: Woodsworth C$2,053.13 to Trinity C$2,842.93 in 2026-27). UHIP (C$948) excluded. Not fixed: international fees rise yearly for continuing students too. Years 2-4 (Honours BA) are charged the same C$66,110 program fee in 2026-27. 2025 from the Tuition Explorer 2025-26 schedule (University College); 2024 from the archived 2024-25 Arts & Science University College international fee schedule PDF (Table 1A).

UHIP (C$948) excluded. Not fixed: international fees rise yearly for continuing students too. programmes.name: Master of Arts in Economics (MA), Faculty of Arts & Science

programmes.name: Master of Business Administration (Full-Time MBA), Rotman School of Management
programmes.summary: First-year tuition for the 2-year MBA; the second year is charged at that year's higher rate. Compulsory university fees included; the business school's own fees and health insurance are extra.
programmes.notes: 2026-27 international program fee C$71,670 per academic year for the 2-year Full-Time MBA (students admitted 2026) from the U of T Tuition Explorer; compulsory = incidental and system access fees C$2,392.69 (Rotman's own ancillary fees, about C$650, are not in the schedule and are excluded). UHIP (C$948) excluded. Not fixed: Rotman estimates total international academic fees of C$144,770 for the programme, i.e. the second year is billed at that year's higher rate. 2025 from the Tuition Explorer 2025-26 schedule; 2024 from the archived 2024-25 SGS international fee schedule PDF (Table 20).

programmes.name: Master of Science in Applied Computing (MScAC), Department of Computer Science
programmes.summary: Programme total for this 16-month master's spread over 1.33 years, plus a one-off C$2,200 pre-programme fee. Compulsory fees included; health insurance is extra.
programmes.notes: 16-month programme (Sep-Dec of the second year). Total programme fee at 2026-27 rates = Fall-Winter full-time program fee C$50,070 (SGS fee regulations: students who pay the full-time Fall-Winter fee pay nothing for the following Summer session, and the MScAC page confirms no payment in semester 3) + final Fall term fee C$25,035 (the Tuition Explorer 'Fall or Winter' schedule, half the Fall-Winter fee) = C$75,105, divided by 1.33 years. Compulsory = Fall-Winter incidental and system access fees C$2,292.39 (C$1,177.09 for the final Fall term alone). One-off = C$2,200 mandatory pre-program activities fee quoted on the MScAC 'Apply' page (read via r.jina.ai on 2026-10-01; that page estimates about C$90,050 all-in for the September 2026 intake). UHIP (C$948) excluded. Not fixed. 2025 = 2025-26 Fall-Winter C$47,690 + Fall-only C$23,845 over 1.33 years (Tuition Explorer); 2024 = 2024-25 C$45,420 + C$22,710 over 1.33 years (archived 2024-25 SGS international fee schedule PDF, Table 55).
